BusinessˆaccountsˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆonlyˆoffersˆpersonalˆaccounts.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆbusinessˆaccountsˆforˆcompanies,ˆpartnerships,ˆnonprofitsˆorˆsoleˆproprietors.ˆ##ˆUsingˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆforˆbusinessˆPersonalˆaccountsˆareˆforˆpersonalˆuse.ˆSmallˆamountsˆofˆfreelanceˆorˆsideˆincomeˆareˆfine,ˆsuchˆasˆgettingˆpaidˆforˆoccasionalˆgigs.ˆRunningˆaˆbusiness'sˆregularˆpaymentsˆthroughˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆisn'tˆallowed,ˆandˆcouldˆleadˆtoˆaˆreviewˆofˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆpaymentsˆintoˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆpaymentsˆfromˆaˆbusiness,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployerˆorˆaˆclient,ˆintoˆyourˆpersonalˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆdebitˆcardsˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆisˆaˆpersonalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆcan'tˆcarryˆaˆbusinessˆname.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆWeˆonlyˆissueˆinterestˆtaxˆforms.ˆWeˆcan'tˆissueˆformsˆforˆbusinessˆincome.ˆ##ˆLookingˆforˆaˆbusinessˆaccount?ˆYou'llˆneedˆaˆbankˆthatˆoffersˆbusinessˆaccounts.ˆWeˆcan'tˆrecommendˆaˆspecificˆone.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="support-complaints">
MakingˆaˆcomplaintˆIfˆyou'reˆunhappyˆwithˆsomethingˆwe'veˆdone,ˆtellˆus.ˆYouˆcanˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaintˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆcomplainˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆsayˆyou'dˆlikeˆtoˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaint.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆwhatˆyou'dˆlikeˆusˆtoˆdo.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆitˆtoˆourˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆ-ˆWeˆacknowledgeˆyourˆcomplaintˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ-ˆWeˆsendˆaˆfinalˆresponseˆwithinˆ15ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆmoreˆtime,ˆforˆexampleˆbecauseˆwe'reˆwaitingˆonˆanotherˆbank,ˆwe'llˆtellˆyouˆwhyˆandˆwhenˆtoˆexpectˆanˆanswer.ˆ##ˆOurˆresponseˆTheˆfinalˆresponseˆexplainsˆwhatˆweˆfound,ˆwhatˆwe'llˆdo,ˆandˆyourˆoptionsˆifˆyou'reˆstillˆunhappy,ˆincludingˆwhereˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆyourˆcomplaintˆoutsideˆTallowbrook.ˆ##ˆLegalˆmattersˆIfˆyourˆmessageˆinvolvesˆlegalˆactionˆorˆaˆregulator,ˆsupportˆpassesˆitˆstraightˆtoˆtheˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆMakingˆaˆcomplaintˆneverˆaffectsˆhowˆweˆtreatˆyourˆaccount.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="support-what-we-can-do">
WhatˆourˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆsortˆoutˆmostˆthingsˆduringˆyourˆchat.ˆSomeˆrequestsˆgoˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteam,ˆandˆaˆfewˆthingsˆweˆcan'tˆdoˆatˆall.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcanˆ-ˆFreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆyourˆcardˆ-ˆReportˆaˆcardˆlostˆorˆstolenˆandˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆ-ˆOpenˆaˆdisputeˆthat'sˆinsideˆitsˆwindow,ˆhasˆposted,ˆandˆtotalsˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆ-ˆRefundˆaˆfeeˆunderˆourˆrefundˆpolicyˆ-ˆChangeˆyourˆplanˆ-ˆCloseˆyourˆaccountˆifˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆzeroˆandˆnothingˆisˆpendingˆorˆdisputedˆ-ˆExplainˆfees,ˆlimitsˆandˆpoliciesˆ##ˆSupportˆpassesˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteamˆ-ˆ**Fraud:**ˆsuspectedˆaccountˆtakeover,ˆremovingˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆscamˆpaymentsˆ-ˆ**Disputes:**ˆdisputesˆaboveˆtheˆsupportˆlimitˆ-ˆ**Verification:**ˆidentityˆchecks,ˆlegalˆnameˆorˆdate-of-birthˆchanges,ˆaccountsˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆ-ˆ**AccountˆServices:**ˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆaˆdeceasedˆaccountˆholder,ˆfinancialˆabuseˆ-ˆ**Complaints:**ˆformalˆcomplaintsˆSpecialistˆteamsˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcan'tˆ-ˆActˆfor,ˆorˆshareˆdetailsˆwith,ˆanyoneˆotherˆthanˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆ-ˆGiveˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadviceˆ-ˆRaiseˆlimitsˆ-ˆRefundˆfeesˆoutsideˆtheˆrefundˆpolicy,ˆorˆopenˆdisputesˆafterˆtheirˆwindowˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
